fact: Imagination is the fourth function of the mind, described as a very vital function because your imagination sets the pace for your destination
The American Heritage dictionary defines imagination as the formation of a mental image of something that is neither perceived as real nor present to the senses
Imagination is the art of image formation
Imagination is the image of your destination, having the image of where you are going fully printed in your mental faculty
Your mental picture is what determines your future
Image formation has its seat in the mind: ideas are turned into pictures in the mind, and these pictures are what create your future

Genesis 13:14-15 is quoted, where God tells Abram after Lot was separated from him to lift up his eyes and look northward, southward, eastward and westward, for all the land which he sees God will give to him and to his seed for ever
Imagination is a pace-setter for your destination: as far as your eyes can see is what shall be given to you, and until you see it God cannot give it
Your mind is your God-given asset in setting the pace for your destination
The author says there is nothing they are seeing in their ministry today that he did not first see

Genesis 11:6 is quoted for the power of imagination: 'Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do'
Imagination is a force for accomplishment, and when it is set, God is committed
The four things to stop thinking are death (God is not a killer), failure (not your heritage), stagnation (not your lot in God), and lack and want because of your country's economy
You are not your country's economist, so what is your business in it
Think straight and you will live straight; think high and you will live high
Most of the evils that befall people are traceable to the images they form in their minds
A man involved in an accident says 'I somehow knew it was coming', and because he did nothing about the negative picture formed, it established a negative future for him

2 Corinthians 10:3-5 is quoted, including that the weapons of our warfare are not carnal but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds, casting down imaginations and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ
Strongholds include imaginations, and negative imaginations are strongholds of the devil
You are expected to cast down every negative imagination and human philosophy that is contrary to the truth
Among the things to cast down are every negative doctor's report and every story told you by your grandfather
When your obedience to this rule is complete you will go ahead to avenge all disobedience
When a picture of an accident flashes through your mind you should cast it down, and not think it will go on its own
Negative imaginations are able to corrupt an entire destiny and devastate a great future

Certain ailments have stayed long in many families because the devil plays around the stronghold of imagination: the grandfather died of that sickness, so did the father, so the man is already expecting it at about the same age
Every positive imagination establishes a positive destination, whereas every negative imagination establishes a negative destination
You must remain a man of determined imagination, constantly seeing what you desire and refusing to embrace what is of the devil
The author cannot imagine Jesus Christ involved in an accident, brought out from under car wreckage with people pouring water on Him and shouting 'Master! Master! Are you still there?'
John 20:21 is the ground of the argument: 'As the Father has sent me, even so send I you', so since he cannot imagine Jesus in that condition he cannot imagine himself in it
The author has been declaring boldly for years 'If there's a crash somewhere, don't look for me there, because I can't be there'

The author cannot imagine Jesus lying on a hospital bed with gadgets attached to His hands and nose and pastors praying 'Master be healed!', so he cannot imagine himself on a hospital bed, because greater is He that is in me than the sickness tormenting humanity in the world
The author cannot imagine Peter, James and John coming to Jesus' home to quell a fight between Him and His wife, saying 'Master, enough, enough'
As a result of the Peter, James and John illustration the author has long been declaring 'I can't imagine me slap my wife'
Your imagination is vital in determining your ultimate destination in life, and your mental picture determines your actual future
You need to jealously guard your mind against every form of negative pollution
Many evils that came upon people did not come straight from the devil; they came as such people gave place to the devil through careless imagination and thoughts

Some are not married yet but already bother about whether they will have children, though they have no medical or physiological problems, and when you call out those looking for the fruit of the womb they are usually the first to come out
Zig Ziglar said 'The most powerful nation in the world isn't America after all, but imagination'
Your imagination determines your rating in the world
A minister of the gospel will never see a big congregation until he starts imagining one, and you will never see a big business until you have a picture of one
